thread:
nina: Quick check on PR #5011 - migrating audit-log examples to SDK v2 and adding a tiny migration checklist. Found two issues: a legacy curl hits /v1 and one doc shows TTL=90 days while policy text says 180. Please review.

sam: on it. which files?

nina: docs/audit/overview.md, docs/sdk/go/audit.md, docs/examples/cli/audit-curl.md

omar: legal note: do not change policy wording or TTL values in the docs without legal sign-off. If TTL is inconsistent, open a legal ticket; docs should only update examples/links.

legal-bot: Confirmed. Docs may modernize code/examples and add redirects. Any retention wording edits must be approved.

sam: i'll replace curl with /v2, bump Go imports to v2, and sanitize examples (no real emails). I'll also add a short migration checklist to the PR description: code updates, link redirects, preview QA, and legal flag if policy mismatch.

nina: please include exact changelog line: "docs-only: examples migrated to SDK v2; no policy or TTL changes."

preview-bot: Preview deployed - https://deploy.preview.redwood/doc/5901234567 PR #5011 :white_check_mark:

nina: thanks. i'll QA the preview and file a legal ticket about the TTL discrepancy rather than editing the policy text.
